notes.title: Pixi Version 1.1.2! Speedrun-only fixes!
notes.content:
An even more minor update to the previous one, all about the speedrun mode introduced in 1.1. 

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug only appearing in speedrun mode where the background color doesn't have the time to be removed with the lack of text.
[*] Fixed choices in a few places on speedrun mode.
[*] Fixed how the game show the time once getting the 100% ending. In speedrun mode, again.
[/list]

Have fun, but especially, have a great speedrun!

notes.title: Pixi Is Finally Out!
notes.content:
That's it! Today's the day, and now Pixi is finally available to purchase and play!

There's a 10% discount going on for the next 2 weeks, and there's a deluxe edition including the artbook/walkthrough.

I'm super proud that after almost two years of development, Pixi will finally be able to be played by everyone. It's been a huge labor of love, learning and drawing. Lots and lots of drawing. I sometimes wondered if I was making new stuff up in my game to have the occasion to draw more. 

Ultimately, I'm proud of my work and I finally feel ready to show it to the world.

Thank you, everyone. For the love, the support, the tests, the hatemail, and even more.
Thanks Pouale for the soundtrack. Thanks again for the soundtrack made more than a decade ago.
Thanks Hack for one drawing, included somewhere inside the game.

List of small bugs to fix:
[list]
[*] -Small sound effect issues when you obtain objects (sometimes)
[*] -Checking the volume and the speed of the music in certain areas
[/list]

Don't hesitate to go to the community tab if you ever find some bugs or some typos. The game contain a massive amount of text in French and English, I couldn't simply go around and finely check through every single line in French and in English. This is all the work of one person, after all!
